name: HOYA Corporation
summary: HOYA Corporation, a med-tech company, provides high-tech and medical products in the Japan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Life Care, and Information and Communications. It offers life care products, including eyeglasses; contact lenses; medical endoscopes; intraocular lenses; laparoscopic surgical instruments; automatic endoscope cleaning equipment; and other medical related products, such as prosthetic ceramic fillers and metallic implants for orthopedics, brain surgery, and dentistry.
